# Athens night desk

> €120 once: a live local page the same night you pay. Name, what you do, tap-to-call or email.

This is the same product as [120.cash](https://120.cash/). 120.cash is indexed and still says a working day. This night desk uses the same keychain.gr till (`cash_120`, card or PayPal) and publishes as soon as payment clears.

Do not restore FormSubmit. Do not send cold email. Phone is optional; the live page uses email if there is no number.

- [Riza (sample, not a real shop)](https://agency002com-ship-it.github.io/riza-kypseli.html)

## After pay

The return opens a live URL on this site. The brief is also posted to 120.cash so the night desk can file it. Income is not counted until a real Stripe `cs_live_` or PayPal `PAYID-` lands.
